review.reviewNotes: Eight distinct full-body right-facing layup poses. Accu’s warm skin, green eyes, black blunt bangs, close-cropped sides, two long black twin ponytails, human anatomy and teal/violet/black kit remain consistent. Takeoff at frame1/tick2; single one-handed release at frame4/tick10; landing/recovery at frame7.
